schema.elements: elements[id] is an exact actionable/fixed element descriptor; string fields use strings ids
schema.fixed_sticky_overlap: overlay and target element ids plus exact intersection rect
schema.geometry: horizontal_targets, below_fold_targets and scroll_ownership are copied from R4; element lists are ids
schema.rows: one row per R4 stress-facts record; list values are element ids unless otherwise noted
schema.strings: strings[id] decodes string-valued element fields; id 0 is null/empty
schema.viewport_and_overflow: viewport_css and overflow retain R4 dimensions and scroll dimensions
